text_classification.prompt: Classify the sentiment of the following sentence. Answer with exactly one label: positive or negative. Do not provide any explanation.

image_classification.prompt: Classify this image into exactly one of the following categories: tench, English springer, cassette player, chain saw, church, French horn, garbage truck, gas pump, golf ball, parachute. Output only the category name and nothing else.

ocr.prompt: Read the single word shown in this image. Output only the recognized word. Do not provide any explanation.

asr.prompt: Transcribe the English speech in this audio. Output only the transcription. Do not provide any explanation.

text_qa.prompt: Answer the following yes-or-no question using only the provided passage. Answer with exactly one label: yes or no. Do not provide any explanation.

visual_qa.prompt: Answer the visual multiple-choice question using the provided image and question. Answer with exactly one option letter (A, B, C, ...). Do not provide any explanation.

lid.prompt: Identify the spoken language in the provided audio. Answer with exactly one language code and nothing else. Do not provide any explanation.
